findings.title: Native zoom can leave the mobile drawer using desktop modality and focus state on main
findings.description: CSS uses a width media query while panelController.isMobile reads matchMedia, including a fresh query. The October 27 evidence records that both query state and change delivery can lag the native zoom layout. Resize invokes the same stale query reader, so it cannot reliably repair the transition; background focus/isolation can disagree with the visible drawer. The existing stale-query test freezes only the first retained query, leaving fresh queries accurate and missing this case.
findings.status: FIX_LOCAL_ONLY candidate; canonical issue remains PARTIAL
findings.remediation: Review and land width-driven reconciliation plus the regression freezing every query, then obtain blocking pinned browser acceptance.

findings.title: Camera input and Range feedback depend on the next rendering frame
findings.description: Input handlers only queue actions. Main flushes them in its frame pipeline, and Range text is updated after renderer.render. Slow software rendering or initial preparation therefore delays keyboard/tap camera action and feedback. The local candidate applies queued actions in a microtask with a feedback callback; local browser coverage removes the manual step before checking the response.
findings.remediation: Review and land the input/feedback change with immediate-response and follow/free-camera regressions.

findings.title: Composition cleanup skips PlanetQuadtree.dispose
findings.description: Earth, Moon and Mars bodyMeshes entries are quadtree Groups. The unload loop only disposes direct geometry/material properties, which Groups do not have, and never invokes userData.quadtree.dispose(). The class has explicit leaf destruction and material disposal, but this production composition path does not call it. This is a concrete resource-ownership omission; it is not evidence that the repaired near/far LOD merge disappears again.

findings.remediation: Route quadtree Groups through their owner disposal method and add a focused composition cleanup assertion when implementing a repair.
